g.text: Suppressing the carrier and selecting sidebands changes spectral occupancy

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Same sinusoidal1 kHz message and10 kHz carrier reference; retained sideband amplitudes are held at0.3 V for comparison. Positive-frequency peak-amplitude
convention. For a general baseband bandwidth W, AM/DSB occupy2W and one SSB occupies W; single-tone stems do not fill those bands.
